'''Delan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[permitor]] working in the city of [[Depatar/Legends|Depatar]] in [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]]. She had a well-deserved professional reputation, as she managed to get whatever permit her client needed. Any outsider visiting Depatar was required to have a local permitor.

In 31 BBY, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Alec (Jedi)|Alec]] used Delan as his personal permitor during his stay in Depatar. People dealing with Alec were impressed when they noticed how he had any permit he could need, and thus they increased Delan's reputation when talking about it.

Once Alec decided to hide, he paid Delan a week of vacation in the nearby planet [[Dorumaa]], but he kept her [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] signal to contact her should he needed it. Alec disappeared from the public eye, and so did Delan, who apparently told no one about her holiday.
